Answer: A
Reason: The CT images (Figures 1a and 1b) demonstrate a mediastinal abscess with air-fluid levels adjacent to the aorta (indicated by the arrow in 1a) and a large right pleural effusion. In the context of an aorto-oesophageal fistula, the progression would involve worsening infection leading to increased effusion size and persistent or new mediastinal air, which aligns with option A. Options suggesting resolution or normal findings contradict the severe pathology shown.
